event.a4_a1373397.title: Act IV Opens
event.a4_a1373397.body: Ground power is booked years out, rockets fly every week, and a handful of companies are filing claims on lunar ridges. Nobody can tell you which way the next five years break. Read the signals.
event.a4_4c0f116a.title: The Space Act Applies
event.a4_4c0f116a.body: A large market’s new space law takes effect: operators serving its customers must file debris plans and pay for compliance reviews.
event.a4_9d8e3e28.title: The Sixth Halving
event.a4_9d8e3e28.body: The block subsidy halves again. Old miners that barely paid their power bill now lose money every hour they run.
event.a4_5c0c1928.title: New Reactors on the Grid
event.a4_5c0c1928.body: The first new-build fission plants of the decade start feeding the grid. Their owners are taking calls about long power contracts.
event.a4_5c0c1928.choice.c1: Spend goodwill for a place in the queue
event.a4_78e2412d.title: Boots on the Rim
event.a4_78e2412d.body: A crewed landing near the lunar south pole plants a flag beside the ridges everyone wants. Landers with spare cargo space start calling resource companies.
event.a4_8db4f7c9.title: A Lander Tips Over
event.a4_8db4f7c9.body: A commercial lander touches down on a slope and tips onto its side. Its payloads are lost; its insurers settle in a week.
event.a4_6ff0e9d1.title: Milestone Deadlines Loom
event.a4_6ff0e9d1.body: Constellation licences filed under the 2026-era rules come due: a share of the filed capacity must be in orbit by set dates, or the licence shrinks.
event.a4_b8e08dfa.title: A Station at the Pole
event.a4_b8e08dfa.body: The Station partnership opens a basic outpost near the south pole, on a ridge two other claimants had circled. Every lunar claim now has a neighbour.
event.a4_8c08e06f.title: A Cheaper Ride
event.a4_8c08e06f.body: Carrack Heavy’s sales team calls with a third-party seat on a reused booster for late 2032, quoted under list. “Book early,” they say. “It only gets cheaper from here.”
event.a4_8c08e06f.choice.c2: Brief your lenders on an orbit plan
event.a4_32e1d9ea.title: Debris Alerts Spike
event.a4_32e1d9ea.body: A spent upper stage breaks apart in a lower orbit and sets off a week of conjunction alerts. Insurance brokers start calling about cover.
event.a4_32e1d9ea.choice.c2: Retain a broker and pause orbit work
event.a4_7fb324c7.title: Ten Flights, One Booster
event.a4_7fb324c7.body: The same Carrack booster flies its tenth mission in a quarter. Analysts redraw their launch-cost curves; two lenders ask for your orbit numbers.
event.a4_0cd98507.title: The Booster Hits Its Price
event.a4_0cd98507.body: Carrack Heavy posts a third-party price of $450 a kilogram and says the curve keeps bending. Space stocks jump, and lenders who wouldn’t take your call last year are asking about orbital capacity.
event.a4_0cd98507.choice.c1: Ride the wave: reprice your debt
event.a4_97fc33a9.title: Everyone Wants a Shell
event.a4_97fc33a9.body: Frontier labs and inference platforms are queuing for orbital capacity they can have this year, not in five. Your phone doesn’t stop.
event.a4_97fc33a9.choice.c1: Open your book to new tenants
event.a4_5f5010a9.title: Supply Catches Up
event.a4_5f5010a9.body: Three operators launch new blocks in a single quarter. Brokers start talking about a capacity glut in the busy shell.
event.a4_3e67e8b8.title: Rents Slide
event.a4_3e67e8b8.body: Orbital supply puts a ceiling on what tenants will pay on the ground. Your largest tenant asks to extend now, at a little less.
event.a4_3e67e8b8.choice.c1: Extend three years at a discount
event.a4_76ae45e9.title: The Early Builders
event.a4_76ae45e9.body: The operators who launched in 2032 and presold their capacity are the ones still smiling. The late arrivals are discounting.
event.a4_a56760ce.title: Heavier Than Promised
event.a4_a56760ce.body: An engineering review of next-generation compute satellites finds the radiators can’t shrink as advertised: the new birds will weigh nearly as much per megawatt as the old.
event.a4_cb63ae9f.title: A Seat Sale
event.a4_cb63ae9f.body: Carrack Heavy offers spare capacity on its next manifests at a promotional price. “Limited time,” says the email. The list price hasn’t moved.
event.a4_cb63ae9f.choice.c2: Put down a deposit for a block
event.a4_6149429a.title: Brightness Complaints Pile Up
event.a4_6149429a.body: Astronomers and two satellite operators petition regulators to cap new constellations until the sky and the debris are studied.
event.a4_c386ed60.title: The Constellation Cap
event.a4_c386ed60.body: Regulators freeze new constellation filings pending a brightness and debris review. Launch prices hold where they were. Orbit, for now, stays expensive.
event.a4_deab72f0.title: Hot Chips, Cold Margins
event.a4_deab72f0.body: Orbital operators report GPUs failing faster than planned. Tenants who signed for orbit ask about moving workloads back to the ground.
event.a4_deab72f0.choice.c1: Court them for your ground halls
event.a4_6cc6f179.title: Ground Rents Firm
event.a4_6cc6f179.body: With orbit stalled, energized ground megawatts are the scarcest thing in the market. Your largest tenant wants to lock in now.
event.a4_6cc6f179.choice.c1: Extend three years at a premium
event.a4_aba49b1f.title: Orrery Compute Folds
event.a4_aba49b1f.body: The venture-backed orbital startup that raised at a record valuation in 2031 files for protection. Its operations team is looking for work.
event.a4_74523d7f.title: Patience Pays
event.a4_74523d7f.body: The companies that kept their ground megawatts and waited are the ones with cash to spend as orbit’s prices finally start to move.
event.a4_b943e48a.title: Near Miss at 550
event.a4_b943e48a.body: Two satellites in the dawn-dusk shell pass within a few metres of each other. Operators report a record month of avoidance manoeuvres.
event.a4_1481a1bf.title: A Rule Floats
event.a4_1481a1bf.body: Regulators publish a draft brightness-and-debris rule for large constellations. Comment letters flood in; nobody knows if it will survive.
event.a4_2f6e59b6.title: Insurers Ask Questions
event.a4_2f6e59b6.body: Space insurers start asking every applicant about collision avoidance in the busy shell. Two of them quietly cut their capacity.
event.a4_2f6e59b6.choice.c2: Buy cover early, at today’s rates
event.a4_7065d64a.title: The Cascade at 550
event.a4_7065d64a.body: A fragmentation event in the dawn-dusk shell sets off a chain of collisions. Regulators close the shell to new launches; insurers stop writing cover there.
event.a4_7065d64a.choice.c2: Draw a credit line while you can
event.a4_c595ce13.title: Insurance Hardens
event.a4_c595ce13.body: After the largest loss in the market’s history, premiums jump and capacity shrinks. Lenders ask every borrower how much of their orbit is insured.
event.a4_c595ce13.choice.c2: Self-insure and take the hit to your rating
event.a4_b5b9ea94.title: The Quiet Shells
event.a4_b5b9ea94.body: Operators move their plans to higher, emptier orbits. Tenants who still want orbit now pay for safety more than for price.
event.a4_fc336087.title: Sovereigns Want Safety
event.a4_fc336087.body: A bloc defence agency wants dedicated compute in a quiet orbit and will prepay for it. It wants a say in where your satellites fly.
event.a4_fc336087.choice.c1: Take the prepayment, accept the strings
event.a4_24c097ce.title: The Moon Looks Different Now
event.a4_24c097ce.body: With the busy shell still crowded with debris, analysts re-rate anything that doesn’t depend on it: high orbit, ground stations, and lunar ridges.
event.a4_5a0b4fe9.title: Record Capacity Auction
event.a4_5a0b4fe9.body: The grid’s capacity auction clears at its price cap. Headlines call it the end of affordable power on the ground; orbit’s promoters send you their decks.
event.a4_9039a87c.title: Fast-Track Rules
event.a4_9039a87c.body: Regulators adopt a large-load order that lets new data-centre connections skip parts of the queue if they bring their own firm power.
event.a4_9039a87c.choice.c1: Spend goodwill to speed a project
event.a4_26ed60a3.title: Turbines Ship
event.a4_26ed60a3.body: Gas turbine makers clear their backlog early. On-site power that took three years to order now takes eighteen months.
event.a4_a1518105.title: The Queue Breaks
event.a4_a1518105.body: Fast-track connections, new firm power and an efficiency jump in the newest chips arrive together. Ground capacity unblocks, and orbit’s speed premium starts to fade.
event.a4_0289ceeb.title: More Work per Watt
event.a4_0289ceeb.body: The newest accelerators do twice the work for the same power. Tenants need fewer megawatts for the same job, wherever those megawatts are.
event.a4_2e3701ca.title: Orbital Rents Soften
event.a4_2e3701ca.body: With ground capacity easier to find, orbital tenants ask for shorter terms and lower prices. The ones on long contracts are glad they signed.
event.a4_c20bf93e.title: Ground Is King
event.a4_c20bf93e.body: Permitted, energized ground megawatts trade at a premium again. An infrastructure fund asks to buy into one of your sites.
event.a4_49f16fcb.title: Orrery Compute Folds
event.a4_49f16fcb.body: The orbital startup that raised at a record valuation in 2031 files for protection, its blocks idle and its tenants gone to the ground.
